title: Men in 1940s Suits Standing Outside Brick Building, B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid outdoor photograph depicting a group of young and middle-aged men congregating outside the entrance of a dark brick facility or venue. They are sharply dressed in classic late 1930s to early 1940s tailoring, featuring double-breasted and single-breasted suits with wide lapels, baggy trousers, newsboy flat caps, and fedoras. One man sits on the steps while others lean against the brick facade and doorways, likely waiting for an event, transit, or a work shift to begin.
